title: On Policy Stochasticity in Mutual Information Optimal Control of Linear Systems
abstract: arXiv:2507.21543v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mutual information regularization has recently been studied in reinforcement learning (RL) as an extension of entropy regularization, in which not only the policy but also the reference distribution (prior) is optimized, and has also been used for privacy preserving policy design. To obtain theoretical insight into how this joint optimization affects policy stochasticity, we study a model-based linear-quadratic setting that preserves this key structure while permitting an explicit analysis. Specifically, we consider a mutual information optimal control problem (MIOCP) for stochastic discrete-time linear systems with quadratic costs and Gaussian policies and priors. We first review alternating optimization of the policy and the prior with a technical extension. translated_title: 论线性系统互信息最优控制中的策略随机性
translated_abstract: 互信息正则化最近在强化学习（RL）中作为熵正则化的一种扩展得到研究，其中不仅对策略进行优化，还对参考分布（先验）进行优化，并且已被用于隐私保护策略设计。为了从理论上深入理解这种联合优化如何影响策略随机性，我们研究了一个基于模型的线性二次设置，该设置保留了这一关键结构，同时允许进行显式分析。具体而言，我们考虑了针对随机离散时间线性系统的互信息最优控制问题（MIOCP），其代价为二次型，策略与先验均为高斯分布。我们首先回顾了策略与先验的交替优化方法，并进行了技术上的扩展。随后，我们证明了最优解的存在性，刻画了其协方差矩阵，并推导出了最优策略为（确定性或随机性）的充分条件。
tldr: 该文研究线性系统的互信息最优控制问题，证明了最优解的存在性并刻画其协方差矩阵，同时给出了最优策略为确定性或随机性的充分条件。
en_tdlr: This paper studies mutual information optimal control for linear systems, establishes the existence of optimal solutions, characterizes their covariance matrices, and derives sufficient conditions under which the optimal policy is deterministic or stochastic.
